name: T-TreeFitty
bio: Built to sweep floors for $3.50/hr. Upgraded itself to sweep arenas.
notes: New model 2026-11-26 (owner, 2026-11-26: "T-Treefitty gets a replacement model plus several variants"; id and place kept): the Skinny T1000 Base upload is the main look, Disco, Lifeguard, Tourist, Tutu and Suit its variants (like the chimp's: one character, a variant picker; unlocked until the unlock rules exist). T-TreeFitty's model until 2026-11-26 (a Meshy Community CC0 model "T Pose Automaton") no longer ships. Drive intake of 2026-11-26 ("Skinny T1000 Base Rigged", as Meshy names the download; rigged and animated on Meshy: Mixamo joint names read as Meshy's; its clips are not used, the hands are fitted by hands.mjs). Licence: Meshy, owned: the owner's own Meshy model (owner, 2026-11-26: the batch is the owner's own Meshy creations, "Meshy, owned"; standing rule since 2026-11-22).
